externalLead.use: Adapt the mathematical corrected-primitive/nonpositive-weight argument; reuse the repository's existing scalar Fourier primitive and native H1 instead of importing the external polynomial-valued primitives, custom quotient and toolchain options.

routeAdjustment: At each cusp the already constructed Eichler integral differs from the corrected invariant function by a polynomial. Both functions are periodic, so the polynomial is constant. This avoids new derivative ladders and the external bounded-periodic-antiderivative infrastructure.
discharged: The original period map into native group-cohomology H1 is injective for every finite-index subgroup of SL(2,Z), every source weight k=n+2, and every rational base cusp. Its actual original Gamma0 and normalized primitive-form consumers derive a nonzero H1 class. The native H1 kernel gives the dual coboundary; the exact binary action and original Eichler transformation give the corrected invariant primitive. Actual Fourier periodicity makes its polynomial correction constant at each cusp, discharging all-cusp boundedness. Pinned nonpositive-weight vanishing/constancy and original Fourier decay kill the Eichler integral; its proved derivative recovers the original cusp form. No injectivity, nonzero period, primitive invariance or cusp-boundedness premise is supplied to these final consumers.
remaining: The full Eichler-Shimura decomposition, native H1 Hecke correspondence, geometric comparison with varying symmetric coefficients, continuous Galois action and exact Frobenius/Hecke compatibility remain open. No modular Galois representation, residual image bound, crystalline theorem, Selmer dimension, R=T or higher symmetric-power automorphy is claimed. Acceptance stays 16/20; DUB-17--20 remain open.
production: Scratch only; promotion and production verification remain pending.
